children: ICICI Securities's research report on Hindalco Industries

Novelis’ Q2FY27 adjusted EBITDA (in-line with our estimate), at USD 508mn, was up by 20% YoY/down 2% QoQ. EBITDA/t stood at USD 533. This was driven by favourable metal benefits, structural cost savings and USD 39mn of Oswego insurance proceeds. Excluding insurance benefits, EBITDA/t stood at USD 510. With Oswego operations gradually ramping up, tariff-related costs expected to moderate and Bay Minette potentially starting H1FY28, we expect a gradual improvement in volumes and profitability through FY27. Structural cost savings are expected to reach USD 300mn by FY27E-end and USD 350–400mn by FY28E-end. We expect debt to start tapering on working capital release and completion of capex. Thus, we retain BUY, with a TP of INR 1,200, based on 7x FY28E EV/EBITDA.
Maintain BUY with a TP of INR 1,200 valuing it at 7x FY28E EV/EBITDA.
